STS2ARIS-ARIS_BASE_RELIC.title: Enhancement Magic!
STS2ARIS-ARIS_BASE_RELIC.description: The first time [gold]Class Change[/gold] triggers each combat, gain {ChargePower:chargeIcon(0)}.
STS2ARIS-ARIS_BASE_RELIC.flavor: "Aris does not believe that magic is absent from Kivotos."
STS2ARIS-ARIS_BASE_RELIC_PLUS.title: Enhancement Magic!+
STS2ARIS-ARIS_BASE_RELIC_PLUS.descriptio: Replaces [red]Enhancement[/red] [red]Magic![/red] The first time [gold]Class Change[/gold] triggers each turn, gain {ChargePower:chargeIcon()}.
STS2ARIS-ARIS_BASE_RELIC_PLUS.flavor: "Magic exists. After all, Sensei has made Aris happy."
STS2ARIS-H_P_POTION.title: HP Potion
STS2ARIS-H_P_POTION.description: At the end of combat, heal 1 HP for each time you took damage during that combat.
STS2ARIS-COPY_CAT.title: Copycat
STS2ARIS-COPY_CAT.description: Choose 1 random character and obtain their starter Relic. Their cards can appear in combat rewards, and Card Rewards contain 1 additional card choice.
STS2ARIS-COPY_CAT.flavor: A life-size Wavecat doll, now selling to rave reviews.
STS2ARIS-T_AS_RELIC.title: TAS
STS2ARIS-T_AS_RELIC.description: Upon pickup, transform all [gold]Quest[/gold] cards in your Deck into their upgraded [gold]Rewards[/gold].
STS2ARIS-T_AS_RELIC.flavor: "Jump there, crouch, and dash to skip that entire section."
STS2ARIS-BATTERY.title: Battery
STS2ARIS-BATTERY.description: The first time [gold]Shock[/gold] is applied to an enemy without Shock, apply [blue]1[/blue] additional Shock.
STS2ARIS-GAME_MANUAL.title: Game Manual
STS2ARIS-GAME_MANUAL.description: At the start of your turn, convert half your [gold]Block[/gold] into [gold]Repair[/gold].
STS2ARIS-GAME_MANUAL.flavor: The manual for a game notorious for being nearly impossible without one.
STS2ARIS-STARTING_EQUIPMENT.title: Starter Equipment
STS2ARIS-STARTING_EQUIPMENT.description: The first [gold]Equipment[/gold] you equip each combat grants [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] and [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold]. This effect only applies while that Equipment is equipped.
STS2ARIS-STARTING_EQUIPMENT.flavor: Equipment given out for free in the starting village.
STS2ARIS-COVERED_KNIFE_SWITCH.title: Circuit Breaker
STS2ARIS-COVERED_KNIFE_SWITCH.flavor: "No, Aris! Don't run the microwave, hair dryer, and air conditioner at the same time!"
STS2ARIS-GAMEBOY.title: Handheld Console
STS2ARIS-GAMEBOY.description: Upon pickup, lose [blue]1[/blue]% Max HP. At the end of each combat, heal all HP.
